bind_enforcement: Per-unit SocketBindDeny=any; listener SocketBindAllow=ipv4:tcp:<exact protected port>; pure client no allow. Require actual supported cgroup bind4/bind6 BPF attachments and positive/negative kernel bind tests, not property text alone.
rules: Only enrolled exact TCP client UID→127.0.0.1:selected listener port (new/established) and exact listener UID source port→client established replies. Input accepts only lo exact127.0.0.1 pairs/selected port or established reply. No blanket established/loopback accept. Every UID is protected exclusive selected role and live managed cgroup identity revalidated; same UID ambiguous unenrolled processes deny activation.
unit_network: Root-held isolated network namespace inode with only lo/no veth/no external routes. All member units use root-derived NetworkNamespacePath, RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET only selected TCP roles; all other workers AF_UNIX. No worker CAP_NET_ADMIN/NET_RAW/SYS_ADMIN or ability to setns/unshare/change nft rules.
